videos.overview: Gruumm brings a noble warrior from the past and tricks him into battling the Rangers.

videos.title: Dismissed
videos.overview: Cruger is relieved from duty when he clashes with the tough SPD Supreme Commander.

videos.title: Perspective
videos.overview: The Rangers relate the capture of a criminal to Cruger, but they all have their own unique version of the story.

videos.title: Messenger (1)
videos.overview: The cadets get a message from the future that today is the day that they will lose the battle of Earth to the Troobians.

videos.title: Messenger (2)
videos.overview: A mysterious Ranger from the future comes to help the Rangers in their hour of need.

videos.title: Zapped
videos.overview: Morgana grants real power to a washed-up magician in her latest attempt to destroy the Rangers.

videos.title: Reflection (1)
videos.overview: Sky must interrogate a notorious criminal when aliens that SPD has already captured attack the Rangers.

videos.title: Reflection (2)
videos.overview: Sky must face off with the criminal who was responsible for the loss of his father.

videos.title: S.W.A.T. (1)
videos.overview: Piggy and friends steal SPD technology; the Rangers are sent to Zentor to train for SWAT mode.

videos.title: S.W.A.T. (2)
videos.overview: Under the command of a tough drill sergeant, the Rangers must learn to work as a team before they can earn a powerful new weapons' technology.

videos.title: Robotpalooza
videos.overview: The Rangers nearly reach their breaking point when both Gruumm and Broodwing send robot after robot to attack the city.

videos.title: Impact
videos.overview: Jack and Sky embark on a dangerous mission to stop an incoming meteor from destroying Earth.

videos.title: Katastrophe
videos.overview: Convinced that the Rangers no longer need her, Kat takes a top-level position at SPD Headquarters.

videos.title: Missing
videos.overview: Bridge is captured and the other Rangers must use all their skills to find him before he is destroyed.

videos.title: History
videos.overview: Broodwing brings the Dino Rangers from the past to fight on the side of evil.

videos.title: Badge
videos.overview: Cruger's old rival teams up with Broodwing to take down the Rangers one by one.

videos.title: Insomnia
videos.overview: The teens grapple with failure after Cruger hails the A squad.

videos.title: Resurrection
videos.overview: Jack needs to decide what he really wants to do with his life and the Rangers are dealt a shocking revelation.

videos.title: Endings (1)
videos.overview: With Cruger captured, the A Squad is sent by Gruumm to finish off the Rangers.

videos.title: Endings (2)
videos.overview: Omni descends to Earth and Gruumm makes his last stand against the Rangers.

videos.title: Wormhole
videos.overview: Gruumm takes The Terror to the past in an attempt to defeat Earth before SPD was formed.

videos.title: Broken Spell (1)
videos.overview: A spell has been broken and evil is emerging to destroy the Earth.

videos.title: Broken Spell (2)
videos.overview: Xander, Vida, Chip and Madison finally tap into their Mystic Force powers. But without a Red Ranger, Udonna and Clare know they are in trouble.

videos.title: Code Busters
videos.overview: Chip and Vida think they can learn more spell codes by doing community service, but learn that real heroes are born in the face of danger.

videos.title: Rock Solid
videos.overview: Nick thinks Madison is too shy. When she gets turned to stone, Nick finds out he's wrong.

videos.title: Whispering Voices
videos.overview: The others think Nick stole some money. Nick hears voices in his head and finds out its Koragg.

videos.title: Legendary Catastros
videos.overview: While in battle, Nick is whisked away with Catastros to another dimension. He must face his fears of Catastros.

videos.title: Fire Heart
videos.overview: Xander thinks he knows how to be a leader. When it comes to getting the Fire Heart before Necrolai, Xander has to follow in order to lead.

videos.title: Stranger Within (1)
videos.overview: DJ Fly, a new DJ, comes to town. Chip finds out that DJ Fly is turning the teens of Briarwood into vampires.

videos.title: Stranger Within (2)
videos.overview: Fly Trap has been destroyed, but Vida is still a vampire. The Rangers find out that Necrolai is the vampire who bit Vida.

videos.title: Petrified Xander
videos.overview: Xander has a big zit. He thinks he can get rid of it by using a perfection potion. Instead Xander starts turning into a tree. Vida has to help Xander and then the Rangers have to protect and figure out the secret of the Fire Heart.

videos.title: The Gatekeeper (1)
videos.overview: Clare takes on the legacy of her mother as the Gatekeeper. Koragg captures Udonna.

videos.title: The Gatekeeper (2)
videos.overview: The gates have been raised and Morticon is set free. Nick goes to save Clare while the others hold off Morticon.

videos.title: Scaredy Cat
videos.overview: Necrolai gets the Rangers to break the force field of a magical cave. Inside the cave is a magical lamp and a petrified mummy. Jenji is found inside the lamp. Imperious is brought to life by Octomus.

videos.title: Long Ago
videos.overview: Imperious turns into Calindor and tries to persuade Udonna into believing he can help Mystic Force. The Rangers are busy trying to fight Jester.

videos.title: Inner Strength
videos.overview: Daggeron teaches Xander that without practice, he can cause harm to the rest of the Rangers. Daggeron sends the teens to Shalifar to help Xander see the meaning of inner strength.

videos.title: Soul Specter
videos.overview: Koragg decides it's time to fight Solaris Knight. Gnatu steals life force from civilians when the Rangers come to stop him. Chip accidentally stumbles upon a soul specter as they battle Gnatu. Daggeron must save Chip from the soul specter while battling Koragg.

videos.title: Ranger Down
videos.overview: Jenji gets jealous of Fire Heart. He takes Fire Heart to live in the forest. When he goes back to find him, Fire Heart is gone.

videos.title: Dark Wish (1)
videos.overview: The Rangers get lazy and use their magic for everything. When fighting becomes too tiring for them, the Rangers want to use Jenji.

videos.title: Dark Wish (2)
videos.overview: Imperious has wished the Power Rangers away. The world has lost its color and evil now rules.

videos.title: Dark Wish (3)
videos.overview: The Tribunal of Magic has turned down the teens' request to restore things to the way they were.

videos.title: Koragg's Trial
videos.overview: Imperious makes Koragg stand trial for his countless failures. In the end, Koragg argues that he fights with honor.

videos.title: Heir Apparent (1)
videos.overview: Daggeron and Udonna finally tell the Rangers the full story of the Great War.

videos.title: Heir Apparent (2)
videos.overview: Koragg was really Leanbow all this time. Nick finds out he's really Leanbow and Udonna's son.

videos.title: The Light
videos.overview: With Udonna gone, Mystic Force faces a new terror. 10 Terrors rise against the Rangers. Magma is the first Terror the Rangers must face.

videos.title: The Hunter
videos.overview: Oculus is chosen to capture the Light. He is able to take all the other Rangers down one by one. In order to defeat him, Nick must learn to connect with Fire Heart.

videos.title: Hard Heads
videos.overview: Nick & Vida keep arguing. Hekatoid slimes them so they can't morph. As stubborn as they are, they need to learn to work together in order to save the others from Serpentina.

videos.title: The Snow Prince
videos.overview: Leanbow is stopping the Master from rising and Sculpin has a plan to stop him. The Snow Prince commands that instead of being teacher, Daggeron should take a lesson from Nick on following his gut.

videos.title: Light Source (1)
videos.overview: Hekatoid has captured Udonna and the Rangers chase after him in his own dimension to rescue her. Daggeron, in the real world, tries to stop all the tadpoles Hekatoid has laid to destroy the world.

videos.title: Light Source (2)
videos.overview: The teens lose their powers trying to save Udonna.

videos.title: The Return
videos.overview: Matoombo is chosen to bring forth the Master. But Matoombo doesn't want to hurt anyone. Vida teams up with him to try to seal the Master away forever.

videos.title: Mystic Fate (1)
videos.overview: Itassis doesn't want to fight for the Master anymore and defies his wishes. The Master takes matters into his own hands and destroys Mystic Mother.

videos.title: Mystic Fate (2)
videos.overview: In the final confrontation with The Master, the Mystic Force has suffered great losses. With Daggeron and Leanbow defeated, the Rangers must use all their magic to try and save both the Surface World and the Magical Realm.

videos.title: Kick Into Overdrive (1)
videos.overview: Billionaire treasure hunter Andrew Hartford finds the ancient Corona Aurora. But in the process, he unknowingly awakens two warring alien brothers.

videos.title: Kick Into Overdrive (2)
videos.overview: Hartford is kidnapped by Moltor, who also steals the Corona Aurora. Mack must prove himself as the Red Ranger and aid the team in saving his father.

videos.title: The Underwater World
videos.overview: Will's self-reliance causes friction within the team. The Rangers seek one of the Corona Aurora gems in the underwater ruins of Atlantis.

videos.title: Heart of Blue
videos.overview: Dax rescues a girl named Mira from a monster attack and they quickly become a couple.

videos.title: Weather or Not
videos.overview: After putting a bystander in jeopardy, Mack doesn't feel he's cut out to be a Ranger.

videos.title: Pirate in Pink
videos.overview: Searching the island of St. Lucia for the first jewel of the Corona Aurora, the Rangers stumble upon the ghost of Brownbeard, the pirate.

videos.title: At All Costs
videos.overview: Ronny's competitive nature begins to annoy her teammates. Will things get worse when she butts heads with Mack over first usage of the latest weapon?

videos.title: Both Sides Now
videos.overview: Will is fired by Hartford for selling Zord tech on the side! Taking his Tracker with him, the Black Ranger joins up with Miratrix.

videos.title: Follow the Ranger
videos.overview: Flurious and Moltor put aside their sibling rivalry and combine forces against the Rangers.

videos.title: Lights, Camera, Dax
videos.overview: Dax gets his big break as an actor, but Mr. Hartford refuses to allow him to take the role, since it may conflict with his Ranger duties.

videos.title: Face to Face (1)
videos.overview: The Rangers visit Rose's college in London to try to get the parchment deciphered, only to lose it to Tyzonn, Moltor's latest alien lizard henchman.

videos.title: Face to Face (2)
videos.overview: Mack joins forces with Tyzonn, learning that the reptilian creature is actually a human from the planet Mercury, cursed by Moltor.

videos.title: Man of Mercury (1)
videos.overview: The search for the next jewel leads the Rangers to Portugal and then to Brazil, with a new group of villains always one step ahead of them!

videos.title: Man of Mercury (2)
videos.overview: It's up to Mr. Hartford to restore the liquidized Tyzonn to his human form.

videos.title: Behind the Scenes
videos.overview: Tyzonn gets trapped between his human and mercury forms! Can he be saved in time to aid the Rangers against the Giant Robot-piloting Fearcats?

videos.title: Just Like Me
videos.overview: Will attempts to teach Tyzonn how to blend in on Earth, but when the Mercurian starts to copy Will a little too closely, they clash.

videos.title: It's Hammer Time
videos.overview: With the Cannon of Ki Amuk and Mjolnir in their possession, the Rangers track the next clue to Mexico.

videos.title: Out of Luck
videos.overview: Having swiped the Paedra Aztec Del Compass from the Rangers, Moltor puts it in the possession of his old friend Blothgaar.

videos.title: One Gets Away
videos.overview: Using the compass, the Rangers finally find the Third Jewel of the Corona Aurora.

videos.title: Once a Ranger (1)
videos.overview: The son of Lord Zedd and Rita Repulsa, Thrax, unites all four Corona Aurora-seeking factions of villains into a new Evil Alliance.

videos.title: Once a Ranger (2)
videos.overview: No longer having Ranger powers, the former Overdrive Rangers return to their civilian lives.

videos.title: One Fine Day
videos.overview: The Rangers get a day off and plan a relaxing picnic in the forest. Unfortunately for Rose, Tyzonn is obsessed with getting to know her better.

videos.title: Ronny on Empty (1)
videos.overview: Ronny runs into a stubborn obstacle named Will while trying to throw a Halloween party.

videos.title: Ronny on Empty (2)
videos.overview: Norg and Will strike up a strange alliance in their attempt to find the Fearcats' secret hideout.

videos.title: Things Not Said
videos.overview: While battling one of Kamdor's monsters, the Rangers get their computer systems infected with a virus.

videos.title: Red Ranger Unplugged
videos.overview: After learning about his true robotic nature, Mack starts to go through an identity crisis.

videos.title: Home and Away (1)
videos.overview: Mig and Benglo utilize the power of the Octavian Chalice and unleash the mighty Agrios, a giant robotic creature.

videos.title: Home and Away (2)
videos.overview: While the other Rangers continue to be outmatched by the Fearcats and Agrios, Tyzonn begins to accept his fiancée's claims that he never was a Ranger.

videos.title: Way Back When
videos.overview: Using Mack's internal CPU to review their Ranger careers, the team takes the time to refresh their memories as to who has which Corona Aurora jewel.

videos.title: Two Fallen Foes
videos.overview: Using the Octavian Chalice, the Rangers journey to Greece in an attempt to find the next jewel via an ancient ritual.

videos.title: Nothing to Lose
videos.overview: The Rangers return to Egypt and then travel to Japan in their heated quest to find the key to unlock the last hidden jewel.

videos.title: Crown and Punishment
videos.overview: With the ultimate power of the completed Corona Aurora at his disposal, Flurious freezes all of San Angeles and prepares to conquer the world.

videos.title: Welcome to the Jungle (1)
videos.overview: Theo, Lily and rookie Casey are chosen to become the latest guardians of Dai Shi, an ancient imprisoned spirit.

videos.title: Welcome to the Jungle (2)
videos.overview: With Mantor still plaguing the city, the Rangers are in desperate need of learning the ability to bring themselves up to his size.

videos.title: Sigh of the Tiger
videos.overview: Casey requests extra training from RJ, the spirit of the buffalo is harnessed for evil, and Fran protects the pizza parlor from a children's party.

videos.title: A Taste of Poison
videos.overview: The Five Fingers of Poison are brought forth by Dai Shi, who doubly stuns the Rangers by finally revealing his human form to be the face of Jarrod.

videos.title: Can't Win Them All
videos.overview: The second Finger of Poison, Gakko, uses his wall-sticking skills to humiliate the Rangers when they try to face him on his own turf.

videos.title: Dance the Night Away
videos.overview: The friendship between Theo and Lily is tested by the Yellow Ranger's budding platonic relationship with Casey.

videos.title: Pizza Slice of Life
videos.overview: With RJ out of town, Casey is left in charge of Jungle Karma Pizza. Instead of asserting himself as the boss, he creates chaos in the pizza parlor.

videos.title: Way of the Master
videos.overview: The heavily armored Pangolin proves to be too tough of a nut for the Rangers to crack. Their only hope is a powerful weapon called the Jungle Mace.

videos.title: Good Karma, Bad Karma
videos.overview: Casey loses his $5 tip to a young boy named Josh, who wants to buy himself a kite.

videos.title: Blind Leading the Blind
videos.overview: Theo spreads his focus too thin, leading his teammates to question his effectiveness in battle. Blind Master Swoop teaches him Bat Spirit techniques.

videos.title: Pushed to the Edge
videos.overview: Believing that Carnisoar's training methods are too harsh, Camille decides to find him a new master and revives Jellica, the Sea Overlord.

videos.title: One Master Too Many
videos.overview: Casey anxiously awaits the arrival of his second master, but RJ begins to feel forgotten as a result.

videos.title: Ghost of a Chance (1)
videos.overview: After another victorious battle against Camille's monsters, the Rangers feel they are unstoppable. But RJ warns them about being overconfident.

videos.title: Ghost of a Chance (2)
videos.overview: With RJ captured, the Rangers must travel to the spirit world to find the last three remaining masters.

videos.title: Bad to the Bone
videos.overview: Everyone makes fun of Lily for being too nice. Lily gets fed up and starts to show her bad side, refusing to help the other Rangers.

videos.title: Friends Don't Fade Away
videos.overview: After his last battle, RJ has major problems controlling his animal spirit. He turns into a werewolf and becomes a big threat to anyone around him.

videos.title: No "I" in Leader
videos.overview: Casey really has grown and stepped up to being the leader of the group. But now, with RJ as a Ranger, Casey feels like a cub all over again.

videos.title: True Friends, True Spirits
videos.overview: Grizzaka sends an evil spirit to cause trouble between RJ and his animal spirit again. The hero in RJ causes him to save Flit.

videos.title: Path of the Rhino
videos.overview: Dominic was sent out by Master Mao to find purpose for his life. He finds out that RJ and the others are Power Rangers and he wants to join them.

videos.title: Dash for the Dagger
videos.overview: Jarrod has found the Rhino Nexus. Dominic is startled by a dream telling him to protect the Control Dagger, as it holds the key to his destiny.

videos.title: Race to the Nexus
videos.overview: The Overlords won't grant the Nexus to the Rangers. Yet, having searched all his life for his destiny, Dominic won't let them stand in his way.

videos.title: Arise the Crystal Eyes
videos.overview: The Phantom Beasts were a notorious force in the Beast Wars. The crystal eyes hold the power to bring back these Phantom Beasts.

videos.title: Fear and the Phantoms
videos.overview: The Phantom Beasts have been brought back to life. Dai Shi has them prove their loyalty by capturing the three masters.

videos.title: Blue Ranger, Twin Danger
videos.overview: The Phantom Beasts call forth the Spirit Rangers, who look and fight exactly like Power Rangers. Our heroes are in for a real fight!

videos.title: One Last Second Chance
videos.overview: To stop the Spirit Rangers, RJ risks destroying his father. Trusting his instincts, he finds that his dad was prepared if this should happen.

videos.title: Don't Blow That Dough
videos.overview: The Rangers get sucked into a cheesy game show about the past season. Camille hosts the game show and a wrong answer could result in being canceled!

videos.title: Tigers Fall, Lions Rise
videos.overview: Dai Shi becomes the Phantom Beast King. Weakened with the loss of his spirit, Casey must summon all the energy he has left to stay alive.

videos.title: The Spirit of Kindness
videos.overview: Whiger was only able to steal the Tiger Spirit from Casey, but not destroy Casey. For his failure, Dai Shi strips him of his power.

videos.title: Maryl and the Monkeys
videos.overview: Camille steals a cloning formula from Maryl. The monkeys duplicate and Camille's plan just might work, but Scorch and Snapper sabotage her plan.

videos.title: To Earn Your Stripes
videos.overview: The day has arrived for the three to get their master stripes. Lily and Theo pass the test to become masters. Casey does not.

videos.title: Path of the Righteous
videos.overview: Nobody believes him, but Casey knows that Jarrod still lives inside of Dai Shi. He goes off on his own to save Jarrod.

videos.title: Now the Final Fury
videos.overview: A new war is about to begin as Dai Shi opens a vortex and resurrects all his fallen warriors. Outnumbered, the Rangers do their best to battle evil.

videos.title: The Road to Corinth
videos.overview: The Venjix computer network is laying ruin to the entire planet, and the human race has retreated into the environmentally shielded city of Corinth.

videos.title: Fade to Black
videos.overview: As Venjix grows stronger, it becomes clear that the Rangers need more than three operators to defend the city.

videos.title: Rain
videos.overview: Dillon goes through a series of tests to see if he even is Ranger material, but the real test comes when he is faced with the choice of seeking out his past or helping the Rangers as promised.

videos.title: Go for the Green
videos.overview: When Ziggy is charged with finding the new Green Ranger, he finds the perfect candidate in Tenaya 7, until he realizes she's a machine working for Venjix!

videos.title: Handshake
videos.overview: When Dillon struggles to activate the invincibility mode of his suit, he challenges Dr. K to come out from behind their protective screen.

videos.title: Ranger Green
videos.overview: Ziggy's recruitment as Ranger Green is put into question when parts of his shady past are revealed. Should the Rangers work with someone who is hated by all seven of Corinth's cartels?

videos.title: Ranger Red
videos.overview: Scott is flooded with memories of his brother when he returns to Marcus' crash site in order to retrieve an over thruster core the Rangers need for the new Megazord configuration.

videos.title: Ranger Yellow (1)
videos.overview: Mr. and Mrs. Landsdown suddenly reappear in Summer's life, intent on making their daughter live up to her promise to marry into a wealthy family.

videos.title: Ranger Yellow (2)
videos.overview: Diamonds and pretty dresses are no longer important to Summer, who finds her true meaning in what she does with the Rangers.

videos.title: Ranger Blue
videos.overview: All his life, all Flynn ever wanted to do was to help people, but his heroics as the Blue Ranger are cut short when there is a malfunction in his suit.

videos.title: Doctor K
videos.overview: While attempting to overcome a power problem with the Rangers' new Zord configuration, Doctor K is haunted by a terrible mistake.

videos.title: Blitz
videos.overview: When Venjix sends an attack bot from Dillon's past to infiltrate the city, Dillon is torn between destroying the bot, or finally finding the answers to his past.

videos.title: Brother’s Keeper
videos.overview: As the Venjix Virus comes closer to taking over Dillon entirely, the other Rangers and Dr. K race to find a way to slow the growth rate of the virus.

videos.title: Embodied
videos.overview: Seeking answers to Dillon's past, the Rangers go outside Corinth to a place Dillon thinks he remembers, unaware that it's a trap set by Venjix himself.

videos.title: Ghosts
videos.overview: The Rangers once again find themselves saved by the Gold and Silver Rangers.

videos.title: In or Out
videos.overview: As the Rangers take a more offensive approach against Venjix, the virus traps the citizens of Corinth inside their own dome and proceeds to suck all the air out of the city.

videos.title: Prisoners
videos.overview: Dillon discovers that his sister might be a prison in the same factory where Gem & Gemma were once held prisoner by Venjix.

videos.title: Belly of the Beast
videos.overview: The Rangers learn they must return to the factory and destroy the Venjix Doomsday Box that is being built.

videos.title: Three's a Crowd
videos.overview: When Gem & Gemma's spontaneous antics nearly get them caught in a trap, they realize that they must work together as a team with the other Rangers.

videos.title: Heroes Among Us
videos.overview: In an effort to impress his father, Scott makes a reckless trip out to the wasteland.

videos.title: Not So Simple
videos.overview: With their resources dangerously low, Dr. K has to trust the untested technology of the WheelZord to try and destroy the latest attack bot.

videos.title: The Dome Dolls
videos.overview: When an Attack Bot puts all of Corinth's men to sleep, it is up to the girls to suit up and defend Corinth.

videos.title: And… Action
videos.overview: For the first time ever, join Ziggy as he takes you behind the scenes of the Power Rangers.

videos.title: Ancient History
videos.overview: Truman discovers that Dr. K was responsible for creating the Venjix Virus.

videos.title: Key to the Past
videos.overview: When Dillon discovers that the two keys to his watch fit together to play another song, he uses it to try to reach Tenaya 7.

videos.title: Beyond a Doubt
videos.overview: Dillon is betrayed after he and Tenaya 7 break into the Venjix Palace to retrieve codes that are needed to stop an attack bot.

videos.title: Control-Alt-Delete
videos.overview: Dillon's search for Tenaya is put on hold when Scott is shot with a key that allows Shifter to control him.

videos.title: Run Ziggy Run
videos.overview: Ziggy must pay back the $5 million he owes Fresno Bob.

videos.title: If Venjix Won
videos.overview: Ziggy accidentally teleports himself and Dr. K into a cave.

videos.title: End Game
videos.overview: Dillon fears the virus will take him over.

videos.title: Danger and Destiny (1)
videos.overview: When the magnetic blast goes off and all the electricity goes out in Corinth, Venjix moves to take the city.

videos.title: Danger and Destiny (2)
videos.overview: The Rangers race to insert a virus into Venjix before he takes over Corinth.

videos.title: The Team Unites
videos.overview: Mike figures out the hard way what it means to be a Samurai Ranger after a Nighlok attacks him and his friends.

videos.title: Deal With a Nighlok
videos.overview: The Rangers step in when a devious Nighlok tricks a young boy into giving up on his baseball dreams.

videos.title: Day Off
videos.overview: Struggling to master a secret power disc, Jayden foregoes a trip with the others to an amusement park where the rest of the team encounters the evil Nighlok Dreadhead.

videos.title: Sticks and Stones
videos.overview: When a Nighlok who uses insults as a physical weapon attacks the Rangers, only Emily is unaffected. To help her teammates, she explains how difficult events in life become an opportunity to grow stronger.

videos.title: A Fish Out of Water
videos.overview: Kevin is assigned the crucial task of catching the elusive SwordfishZord in order to save the other Rangers who have been incapacitated by the stench of the Nighlok Yamiror's breath.

videos.title: There Go the Brides
videos.overview: Dayu crosses into the mortal world to cause misery by kidnapping brides on their wedding day.

videos.title: I've Got a Spell on Blue
videos.overview: A Nighlok uses mind control powers to force Kevin to fight against his fellow Rangers.

videos.title: Forest for the Trees
videos.overview: After Mike goes rogue in battle, Mentor takes Mike's Samuraizer away until he learns a deeper lesson about the nature of the Green Ranger's Symbol Power.

videos.title: Test of the Leader
videos.overview: A Nighlok is sent to stop the Red Ranger from using his special power to seal Master Xandred in the Netherworld forever, but their duel is interrupted by the mysterious Deker.

videos.title: Jayden's Challenge
videos.overview: Jayden leaves the Shiba house hoping to keep the other Rangers out of harm's way, but when a powerful Nighlok attacks, Jayden finally accepts the fact that he needs his team to fulfill his role as the leader of the Samurai Rangers.

videos.title: Unexpected Arrival
videos.overview: A traveling fisherman named Antonio arrives and claims to be the sixth Samurai Ranger.

videos.title: Room for One More
videos.overview: Jayden's childhood friend and self-made Samurai Antonio struggles to be accepted by the team as the Gold Ranger.

videos.title: The Blue and the Gold
videos.overview: As Antonio attempts to gain Kevin's respect as a true Samurai, Octoroo devises a plan to create a stronger portal between the Netherworld and Earth via a secret ancient well.

videos.title: Team Spirit
videos.overview: The Rangers must defeat the evil Splitface who steals people's spirits including the Yellow Rangers before they fall into an eternal sleep.

videos.title: The Tengen Gate
videos.overview: Jayden is poisoned by Octoroo during his attempt to discover the Red Ranger's sealing symbol, which can lock away Master Xandred forever.

videos.title: Boxed In
videos.overview: With Jayden kidnapped by Deker, the other Rangers must summon the strength to fight a mutant Nighlok without their leader.

videos.title: Broken Dreams
videos.overview: When the Gold and Pink Ranger fall under the spell of a dream-inducing Nighlok, the other Rangers must enter the Dream World to save them.

videos.title: The Ultimate Duel
videos.overview: The Rangers try to finish off the dream monster Rhinosnorus while Jayden and Deker finally face off in their ultimate duel.

videos.title: Origins (1)
videos.overview: As invasions from the Netherworld increase, the Red Ranger unites a new team of Samurai Rangers to meet the rising threat.

videos.title: Origins (2)
videos.overview: As the teens continue their transition into their new secret lives as Samurai Rangers, Emily reveals a surprising truth about herself.

videos.title: Party Monsters
videos.overview: Halloween is every Nighlok's favorite day of the year so the creepiest creatures from the Netherworld are just dying to get into the scariest party ever and trade war stories about their battles with the Samurai Power Rangers.

videos.title: Clash of the Red Rangers
videos.overview: The Samurai Rangers team up with the mysterious RPM Ranger Red to fight off dual threats from Master Xandred's Mooger army and a robotic supervillain from the RPM Ranger's dimension.

videos.title: Christmas Together, Friends Forever
videos.overview: Twas the night before Christmas and all through the Shiba House the teens reflect on their first year together as a team and as friends.

videos.title: Super Samurai
videos.overview: The Rangers discover that cracks in the earth are now allowing pools of Sanzu River water to seep into our world from the Netherworld and that a mutated Nighlok is using the evil water to keep from drying out as it wreaks havoc throughout the city.

videos.title: Shell Game
videos.overview: The Rangers struggle to find a way to defeat a Nighlok with an apparently indestructible shell without the help of Antonio, who has unknowingly lost his Samurai Morpher and cannot be reached. Meanwhile, Bulk and Spike find Antonio's Morpher, but think it's a phone that they must return to the original owner.

videos.title: Trading Places
videos.overview: It's mixed-up mayhem when the Rangers encounter Switchbeast, a Nighlok who can trap people's spirits inside common objects. When the monster does this to four of the Rangers, Mike and Emily must figure out how to defeat him on their own.

videos.title: Something Fishy
videos.overview: After Antonio develops an unusual fear of fish that leaves him unable to be the Gold Ranger, his teammates rally to help him overcome it. Meanwhile, a mysterious and powerful new enemy arrives to help Master Xandred in his quest to flood the earth.

videos.title: The Rescue
videos.overview: Octoroo, with the help of the Nighlok Eyescar, kidnaps Antonio and Mentor to use as bait in order to lead the rest of the Rangers into a Mooger trap.

videos.title: The Bullzord
videos.overview: A daring boy named Cody unlocks an ancient seal, releasing an enormous BullZord, the very first Samurai Zord, which rampages across the countryside. The Power Rangers must fight to save the city by capturing the beast and taming it to serve as their newest Megazord.

videos.title: He Ain't Heavy Metal, He's My Brother
videos.overview: When Mia's younger brother comes to town to try and convince her to sing lead in his band, the reunion is anything but sweet music. Meanwhile, Serrator once again attacks the city.

videos.title: Kevin's Choice
videos.overview: When a Nighlok eats his Samuraizer, Kevin is unable to help the team defeat the beast, at the same time that he is missing his old life as a competitive swimmer. Meanwhile, Dayu and Deker make a deal with the evil Serrator.

videos.title: Runaway Spike
videos.overview: While the Rangers battle a crafty Nighlok who creates mirror images of himself to confuse them, Spike realizes that one of the duties of being a Samurai is to share in the responsibilities of day-to-day life and sets off to find a job so he can help pay the rent on his Uncle Bulk's clubhouse.

videos.title: The Strange Case of the Munchies
videos.overview: Emily has a crisis in confidence, just as the other Rangers are affected by a Nighlok's evil black sand, which sends them into a desperate hunger/thirst mode. While Emily and Mentor Ji struggle to manage the hungry Rangers and defeat the Nighlok, Bulk and Spike find Mia's wallet and head to the Shiba House to return it.

videos.title: A Sticky Situation
videos.overview: After a Nighlok glues their hands together, Kevin and Mike learn that working as a team doesn't just mean sharing their strengths; it's knowing when they need to ask for help with their weaknesses as well.

videos.title: Trust Me
videos.overview: Serrator takes the first step in his mysterious master plan to seize the earth by clouding the minds of the people of the island Monalua, spreading paranoia throughout the residents. To stop Serrator, the Rangers will need a special new weapon, the Bullzooka!

videos.title: The Master Returns
videos.overview: As Jayden struggles with his sudden doubts on whether or not he has what it takes to be the Red Ranger, Master Xandred demands Serrator return Dayu's Harmonium, prompting Serrator to reveal his true intentions.

videos.title: A Crack in the World
videos.overview: The Rangers discover that Serrator's recent attacks have an ulterior motive -- to crack open the earth and let the Sanzu flood it and thereby become ruler of both worlds.

videos.title: Trickster Treat
videos.overview: Halloween gets spooktacular when an evil Nighlok invades the Samurai Rangers' dreams and turns them into nightmares.

videos.title: Stroke of Fate
videos.overview: When Serrator asks Deker to fulfill the final piece of his destructive plans, Antonio begs Deker to reconsider his role in the battle between humans and the Nighlok.

videos.title: Fight Fire with Fire
videos.overview: The Nighlok Fiera unleashes an overwhelming attack on the Red Ranger, but when he goes down another Red Ranger takes his place. Which one is the real Red Ranger? The answer will change the Samurai Rangers forever.

videos.title: The Great Duel
videos.overview: As the Rangers attempt to adjust to being led by a new Red Ranger, Jayden struggles to find new meaning in his life.

videos.title: Evil Reborn
videos.overview: Jayden finishes his grand battle against Deker and the other Rangers try to convince him to rejoin their team before Master Xandred reawakens.

videos.title: The Sealing Symbol
videos.overview: With Master Xandred back on Earth, the Rangers finally attempt to use the Sealing Symbol to stop him - only to discover that he has a special new defense against it. Now, they must rise to the challenge and find a new way to defeat him and save the world.

videos.title: Samurai Forever
videos.overview: In a climactic battle, the Rangers face off against Master Xandred for the last time.

videos.title: Stuck on Christmas
videos.overview: The Samurai Rangers get stuck in the Megazord's cockpit on Christmas Eve when it breaks down after battling a Nighlok. Will they be able to make it out in time to celebrate Christmas?

videos.title: Mega Mission
videos.overview: When malicious aliens make their way to Earth's orbit, Gosei decides to form a new team of teenage heroes to defend the planet and carry on the proud tradition of the Power Rangers.

videos.title: He Blasted Me with Science
videos.overview: The alien invaders send Scaraba, an alien scientist, down to Earth to study the human race. Meanwhile, Troy finds himself face-to-face with Creepox.

videos.title: Going Viral
videos.overview: When Noah has trouble lifting Jake's heavy weapon, he begins to doubt his abilities, until he learns that believing in yourself is all that's necessary to get any job done.

videos.title: Stranger Ranger
videos.overview: As the Rangers learn that concentration is essential to perfecting their Ranger skills, they are distracted by a civilian falsely claiming to be a Ranger.

videos.title: United We Stand
videos.overview: Best Friends Gia and Emma are turned into bitter enemies by a vicious monster, Beezara. Meanwhile, the guys are captured by Beezara and turned into her slaves.

videos.title: Harmony and Dizchord
videos.overview: When Dizchord attacks the city with music that produces physical pain, the Rangers must fight back in an unorthodox way with a song of their own.

videos.title: Who’s Crying Now?
videos.overview: After Troy deals with some small-minded bullies at school, the Rangers square off against a more dangerous bully, Creepox.

videos.title: Robo Knight
videos.overview: The mysterious Robo Knight joins the Power Rangers. Can he help them defeat toxic monsters that threaten the Earth?

videos.title: Prince Takes Knight
videos.overview: While the Rangers are unsure about how to work with the newly-arrived Robo Knight, Vrak captures the robotic Ranger in an attempt to reprogram him for his own nefarious purposes.

videos.title: Man and Machine
videos.overview: When a shadow-stealing monster attacks, the Rangers must teach Robo Knight the power of teamwork in order to defeat him.

videos.title: Ultra Power
videos.overview: The Megaforce Rangers must find a powerful ancient weapon called the Wild Sword in the Black Mountains. Vrak plans to get to the sword first where he enlist the help of Distractor.

videos.title: Last Laugh
videos.overview: Gia, Emma, Troy, and Jake are captured by Nojoke during his capture of laughing people. Noah and Robo Knight must overcome their differences to free the captive Rangers and defeat Nojoke.

videos.title: Dream Snatcher
videos.overview: A dream-eating monster called Dream Snatcher preys on Emma after being enhanced by the Aurora Box that belonged to Vrak's family. The Rangers and Robo Knight must rescue Emma's dreams and defeat Dream Snatcher before the Roots of Despair emitted from his victims rot the Earth.

videos.title: Gosei Ultimate
videos.overview: Gosei and the Rangers must work together to defeat Bluefur and Bigs when they use the power of the Aurora Box.

videos.title: Raising Spirits
videos.overview: The Rangers have a strange encounter with a medium on Halloween.

videos.title: The Human Factor
videos.overview: The Megaforce Rangers encounter their first Robotic opponents, who try to convince Robo Knight that humans are the true danger to the Earth.

videos.title: Rico the Robot
videos.overview: When one of Metal Alice's robots malfunctions, Emma and the Power Rangers decide to adopt it and teach it the values of friendship and freedom.

videos.title: Staying on Track
videos.overview: The Megaforce Rangers must race to save the day when Metal Alice plots to throw the city into chaos by derailing a passenger train. Meanwhile, Robo Knight comes closer to understanding humans when he meets a young boy.

videos.title: The Human Condition
videos.overview: Admiral Malkor awakens from his cocoon stronger than ever and determined to destroy the Megaforce Rangers.

videos.title: The Messenger
videos.overview: The Megaforce Rangers' victory over the Warstar aliens is short-lived when they discover Metal Alice has turned Vrak into a powerful and menacing cyborg.

videos.title: End Game
videos.overview: When Cyborg Vrak, Metal Alice and The Messenger launch a vicious attack against the Megaforce Rangers, it will take all their powers and abilities to save the earth.

videos.title: The Robo Knight Before Christmas
videos.overview: Robo Knight learns the true meaning of Christmas from a group of children when he is mistaken for a donated Christmas toy and is shipped in a charity crate to a foreign land.

videos.title: Super Megaforce
videos.overview: With that battle won, the civilians attempt to restore order. Back in the classroom, Mr. Burley lectures with new purpose, stating that when faced with great adversity the human spirit will always prevail. On the beach where Robo Knight fell, Troy remains pensive, more determined than ever to find their lost friend.

videos.title: Earth Fights Back
videos.overview: While the rest of the team works with the civilians to rebuild their city, Troy stumbles upon a plot by the Armada to launch missiles at major cities throughout the world.

videos.title: Blue Saber Saga
videos.overview: After being defeated in battle by a master swordsman monster called Skatana, Noah wonders if he is worthy to be a Power Ranger anymore and ends up training to counter Skatana's attacks.

videos.title: A Lion's Alliance
videos.overview: The Power Rangers take the Sky Ship to Animaria to look for the Red Lion Wild Zord. They soon find themselves in competition against General Peluso who is also after the Red Lion Wild Zord.

videos.title: Samurai Surprise
videos.overview: The emperor unleashes a powerful monster called Matacore to combat the Rangers. When fighting Matacore, the Power Rangers meet Jayden (the Red Samurai Ranger) and Mentor Ji who provide a disk to help them fight Matacore.

videos.title: Spirit of the Tiger
videos.overview: After the magnetic monster Pacha Chamak steals the Power Rangers' weapons, Jake and Emma consult with Casey Rhodes (the Jungle Fury Red Ranger who is now a part-time zookeeper) to learn a special form of martial arts.

videos.title: Silver Lining (1)
videos.overview: When the Armada sends down X Borg platoons after X Borg platoons, the Megaforce Rangers have their encounter with the Silver Ranger even when they are facing off against Gorgax.

videos.title: Silver Lining (2)
videos.overview: Orion explains his origins to the Rangers, Gosei, and Tensou. Meanwhile, Damaras sends Commander Osegain to Earth in a plot to destroy Orion.

videos.title: Power of Six
videos.overview: When the Rangers are sidelined by an energy-draining monster named Skeltox, Jake must get over his jealousy of Orion and help him master the powers of the Sixth Rangers in order to defeat Skeltox.

videos.title: The Perfect Storm
videos.overview: The Rangers are sidetracked from fighting Sirjinkor when Tensou develops amnesia and wanders away from the Command Center.

videos.title: Love Is In the Air
videos.overview: A love potion made by Invidious accidentally makes Levira fall in love with Jake. Upon discovering this, Invidious plans to eliminate Jake so that he can have Levira for himself.

videos.title: United as One
videos.overview: When the Legendary Megazord is damaged in a fight against Desolar (who is stealing the happiness from humans in order to cure Prince Vekar's cold), Emma uses unconventional methods to defeat this unusual monster.

videos.title: The Grass is Always Greener... or Bluer
videos.overview: A body-swapping monster named Tranceferer switches Jake and Noah's bodies while on a mission to swap the bodies of high-ranking people. While Tranceferer continues his mission, the monster Turtlelini is sent down to distract the Rangers causing Jake and Noah to handle fighting in each other's bodies.

videos.title: In the Driver's Seat
videos.overview: The Rangers are lured away from Earth and into Corinth by Professor Cog who locks the wormhole to Corinth. While the Rangers work to tame the Turbo Falcon Zord, Professor Cog and his Grinders attack Earth and runs into competition in the form of the Armada. The Rangers must find a way to tame the Turbo Falcon Zord and find a way back to Earth to stop Professor Cog.

videos.title: All Hail Prince Vekar
videos.overview: The Rangers finally battle Prince Vekar face to face when he comes to Earth armed with his very own Megazord.

videos.title: Vrak is Back (1)
videos.overview: Following Prince Vekar's destruction, Vrak resurfaces and makes his latest plan to destroy Earth with the help of a reprogrammed Robo Knight.

videos.title: Vrak is Back (2)
videos.overview: With two of the drills in the Earth, the Rangers must rescue Orion from Vrak and free Robo Knight from Vrak's control before the final drill can be placed.

videos.title: Emperor Mavro
videos.overview: Emperor Mavro comes to Earth following the deaths of his sons Vrak and Prince Vekar and replaces Prince Vekar's fleet with his own fleet. He also plans to punish Damaras for what happened to Prince Vekar, yet gives a chance to Damaras to redeem himself by destroying the Power Rangers.

videos.title: The Wrath
videos.overview: Emperor Mavro launches an attack on Earth by calling all Armada forces across the galaxy to drop what they are doing in their positions and head to Earth. He also sends Levira to fight the Rangers in order to redeem herself for the death of Prince Vekar and Vrak and to make up for Damaras' failure.

videos.title: Legendary Battle
videos.overview: When The Emperor nearly defeats the Rangers after a massive attack, the Rangers get help from Legendary Rangers from the past.

videos.title: Powers From the Past
videos.overview: Millions of years after the mysterious and powerful Energems were entrusted to the now extinct dinosaurs for protection from a ruthless bounty hunter, a pair of courageous teens find themselves in possession of two of these long lost precious artifacts, and come face to face with a monster who will do everything in his power to steal them for himself.

videos.title: Past, Present and Fusion
videos.overview: A new teen finds his own Energem and joins Tyler and Shelby on their pilgrimage to the Dinosaur Museum, where they learn they are a part of the elite team called the Power Rangers. They are entrusted with protecting the Energems from a fierce bounty hunter named Sledge, who has returned and is more determined than ever to capture the Energems for himself.

videos.title: A Fool's Hour
videos.overview: Sledge arrives on Earth to confront Keeper and the Rangers. He gives them a deadline to return the Energems, but coming up with a plan to fight back gets compromised when Tyler goes after Fury on his own. Can the Rangers figure out how to work as a team?

videos.title: Return of the Caveman
videos.overview: Chase tries to help Koda adapt to modern day technology after he struggles to learn how to ride their new high tech Dino Cycles. But when they are caged in a cave by one of Sledge’s monsters, Koda must rely on his caveman instincts to escape and save his friend.

videos.title: Breaking Black
videos.overview: When a Maori fortune teller asks Chase for help guarding her shop from a potential thief, Chase is happy to help, but falls under a spell of Sledge’s latest monster, Spellbinder. The rest of the Rangers must quickly figure out how to help break Spellbinder’s hold on Chase before their friend is lost to them forever.

videos.title: The Tooth Hurts
videos.overview: When faced with the fast-firing Cavity monster, Riley thinks Chase doesn’t take the threat seriously, but soon learns that Chase simply has a different approach.

videos.title: Let Sleeping Zords Lie
videos.overview: When Sledge’s monster stings the Anklyo Zord, Shelby must use her advanced dino knowledge to tame the wild beast.

videos.title: Double Ranger, Double Danger
videos.overview: When clone Rangers steal the real Rangers' irreplaceable tracking device, Fury learns the location of the powerful Ptera Zord.

videos.title: When Logic Fails
videos.overview: The Maze monster, working with Fury, captures the Rangers until Riley's logical mind helps them break free. But the delay has allowed Fury time to head toward the Ptera Zord.

videos.title: The Royal Rangers
videos.overview: When the Rangers find the Gold Energem among the Royal Treasure, they decide to impersonate a Prince and Princess to lure Fury in and gain control of the power Ptera Zord.

videos.title: Break Out
videos.overview: Koda and the Rangers fight to save an arrogant prince and the Gold Energem from Fury, but a powerful 800-year-old knight seizes the jewel for himself.

videos.title: Knight After Knights
videos.overview: The Rangers must demonstrate their value to persuade their latest ally, the Gold Ranger, but find they do not have the willpower to do so when one of Sledge's monsters steals their courage.

videos.title: Sync or Swim
videos.overview: A fun rivalry between Tyler and Ivan becomes a problem when it interferes with the efforts of the Rangers to find and defuse a bomb planted by Sledge's monsters.

videos.title: True Black
videos.overview: When three Rangers become trapped in an underground tomb, it's a race against time for Chase to master his new power upgrade before his friends are lost forever.

videos.title: The Ghostest With the Mostest
videos.overview: When a monster kidnaps a Ranger and takes on their appearance during a Halloween party, Kendall must discover which of the team is the fake before their Energem is stolen.

videos.title: Rise of a Ranger
videos.overview: Prince Phillip discovers money can't buy the respect of an Energem when he embarks on his own quest to become a Power Ranger.

videos.title: No Matter How You Slice It
videos.overview: When one of Sledge's monsters manages to break the Rangers' bonds of friendship, it's up to Riley and Koda to remind their team what they truly mean to each other.

videos.title: World Famous (In New Zealand)
videos.overview: When one of Sledge's transport pods is spotted in New Zealand, the Rangers head to Auckland and are shocked to discover the existence of a new Ranger.

videos.title: Deep Down Under
videos.overview: With the Purple Energem in hand, the Rangers race to find the Plesio Zord before Sledge can destroy it for good.

videos.title: Wishing for a Hero
videos.overview: While searching for a new Purple Ranger, the teens find all their personal wishes coming true in the worst way.

videos.title: Race to Rescue Christmas
videos.overview: When Poisandra steals Santa's computer, it's up to the Rangers to get it back before Christmas is canceled.

videos.title: One More Energem
videos.overview: With two Energems in Sledge's possession, the Rangers and Kendall must take the fight to his ship in order to save the world.

videos.title: When Evil Stirs
videos.overview: The Rangers believe their work is done after they've defeated Sledge and his evil monsters. Unbeknownst to them, an even more powerful monster is picking up where Sledge left off and is closer to the Rangers than they think.

videos.title: Forgive and Forget
videos.overview: Snide plans to contaminate the city water with venom that makes you forget who you are in hopes that the Rangers will be infected. Meanwhile, Riley has a score to settle with an old rival at the Amber Beach Marathon.

videos.title: Nightmare in Amber Beach
videos.overview: Shelby receives a pillow from an unknown sender. When she uses it to take a nap, she starts living a nightmare. The Rangers suspect this must be from Snide so they all make sure to stay awake, but that proves to be harder than they thought.

videos.title: A Date with Danger
videos.overview: Chase tries to impress his new girlfriend, Kaylee by showing how talented and accomplished he is. But when it becomes more about him and less about her, Kaylee starts to fall for the Black Ranger instead.

videos.title: Roar of the Red Ranger
videos.overview: Tyler tries to master the new T-Rex Super Charge Mode, but after Heckyl plants a virus in Kendall's computer, the T-Rex Super Charger malfunctions and makes Tyler go wild! Luckily, the Aqua Ranger is able to step in before it's too late.

videos.title: Forged Under Fire
videos.overview: Tyler looks forward to catching up with his dad after not seeing him for the past 10 years. When Tyler's Energem becomes cracked, he is forced to mend it by placing it in Hot Lava and prove to his dad he's not a kid anymore.

videos.title: Home Run Koda
videos.overview: Kendall creates a new Victory Charger that requires the core 5 Energems. But when Riley becomes Koda's coach on the Amber Beach Earthquake baseball team, he has a hard time pulling himself away from the game to help the other Rangers.

videos.title: Riches and Rags
videos.overview: When Ivan mistakes a thousand year old suit of armor as a training dummy, he finds himself in debt after destroying it. Heckyl sends in a hybrid monster named Spell Digger to spread greed to anyone who touches his gold coins.

videos.title: Besties 4Eva
videos.overview: Shelby's lifelong friend Erin starts to take credit for a song that Shelby wrote when they were kids. But when Erin starts to take credit for the work of the Pink Ranger, she quickly realizes how dangerous it can be to claim ownership of someone else's work.

videos.title: Gone Fishin
videos.overview: The Silver Ranger contacts Kendall from the far reaches of space to let them know where the location of a new Zord. When Singe and Fury intercept the message it becomes a race to see who can get there first.

videos.title: Love at First Fight
videos.overview: Poisandra's magic paint and brush are exactly what Beauticruel needs to make any guy she desires fall in love with her. Heckyl devises a plan to make the Rangers fall in love with her so he can steal their Energems

videos.title: Catching Some Rays
videos.overview: The Rangers discover the cave where Koda and his family once lived. Questioning the wise words of his Grandfather, Koda opens a section of the cave he was told to never enter, allowing an ancient monster to escape.

videos.title: Recipe for Disaster
videos.overview: Chase is determined to master a dessert recipe from New Zealand, when a food critic visits the Dino Bite Café. Meanwhile, an evil monster comes to earth to find the Energems and takes control of the Zords and Megazords.

videos.title: Silver Secret
videos.overview: Tyler joins Shelby in auditioning for an open spot on the popular New Zealand band, The N-Zed Boys. Meanwhile, an ally arrives, but not before the Rangers suspects he has an ulterior motive.

videos.title: Trick or Trial
videos.overview: The Rangers are forced to go to intergalactic trial for crimes against monsters.

videos.title: Wings of Danger
videos.overview: The Rangers learn the history of their Energems from a newfound ally. Meanwhile, an epic battle ensues in the forest over the Silver Energem.

videos.title: Freaky Fightday
videos.overview: A monster switches the Rangers' bodies, thereby creating trouble for them. Ivan meets his look-alike who turns out to be his great great great grandson.

videos.title: Worgworld
videos.overview: A new exhibit comes to the Amber Beach Museum: Worg, the robotic caveman. Arcanon sends a musician duo whose music can turn listeners into zombies.

videos.title: The Rangers Rock!
videos.overview: A new monster attacks the Rangers, turning most of them to stone. Shelby must work with Keeper to create a new Zord, the only plan that can save her friends.

videos.title: Edge of Extinction
videos.overview: The Rangers find themselves needing help in their toughest fight yet as they do battle with Snide one final time, and Sledge's eggs hatch across the four corners of the Earth.

videos.title: End of Extinction
videos.overview: The Dark Energem creates a black hole that takes the Rangers back in time, as they must go to a prehistoric age for their final showdown with Sledge and Fury.

videos.title: Here Comes Heximas
videos.overview: When the Power Rangers receive mysterious Secret Santa gifts, they uncover an evil plot to ruin Christmas.

videos.title: Return of the Prism
videos.overview: A young teen named Brody escapes to Earth from an alien spaceship with a special artifact called the Ninja Nexus Prism. He and two new friends must unlock its secrets to defend it from the villainous champion Galvanax.

videos.title: Forged in Steel
videos.overview: As Brody, Preston and Sarah return to Brody's childhood home in an attempt to find his lost family, Hayley and Calvin come across a strange alien named Mick.

videos.title: Live and Learn
videos.overview: Brody is accused of cheating on his first day of school after using his Data Comm to find answers. Now, he must use his own abilities and leadership skills to lead the Rangers against another threat from Galvanax.

videos.title: Presto Change-O
videos.overview: Preston is amazed to discover that he has developed real magical abilities; Galvanax hatches a plan with a new monster to steal the ninja power stars.

videos.title: Drive to Survive
videos.overview: When the Power Rangers are caught in the spider web prison of Galvanax's latest monster, Tangleweb, Calvin must conquer his fear to unlock a new power and save them.

videos.title: My Friend Redbot
videos.overview: Hayley is targeted by Galvanax’s latest monster. Isolated from the other Rangers, she and Redbot must work together to save themselves.

videos.title: Hack Attack
videos.overview: Determined to take part in as many student activities as she can, Sarah builds a device that allows her to clone herself, but the plan backfires when Galvanax's monster steals the technology for himself!

videos.title: Gold Rush
videos.overview: Both the Power Rangers and Galvanax attempt to find more information about the new mysterious Gold Ranger.

videos.title: Rocking & Rolling
videos.overview: Levi is excited to be embarking on his world tour, but as mysterious earthquakes start shaking up Summer Cove, he's presented with a tough decision.

videos.title: The Ranger Ribbon
videos.overview: When Summer Cove's sentimental "Ribbon Tree" is in danger of being cut down by Preston's wealthy father, Preston must learn to stand up to his father to save what is important.

videos.title: Poisonous Plots
videos.overview: Galvanax's latest contestant poisons Brody and the Rangers must make the ultimate sacrifice to save him.

videos.title: Family Fusion
videos.overview: The Rangers access a powerful new Megazord formation to battle Ripcon.

videos.title: Ace and the Race
videos.overview: Calvin finds himself increasingly distracted from his friends and Power Ranger duties when he spends all his time trying to impress his local hero.

videos.title: The Royal Rival
videos.overview: A mysterious princess and her royal guard arrive on Earth to challenge the Rangers.

videos.title: The Royal Rumble
videos.overview: The Power Rangers band together with a new ally to try and defeat Galvanax's new champion -- but even their teamwork may not be enough.

videos.title: Grave Robber
videos.overview: The Power Rangers celebrate Halloween by playing a spooky new board game, but find the stakes bigger than they imagined.

videos.title: Monkey Business
videos.overview: Hayley and Calvin's relationship is tested when they both decide to run for student body president.

videos.title: The Adventures of Redbot
videos.overview: Redbot documents the adventures of the Power Rangers on his new blog, while a cat-like monster attempts to steal the Ninja Power Stars.

videos.title: Abrakadanger
videos.overview: Preston must confront one of Galvanax's newest contestants after his magical spells backfire on his teammates.

videos.title: Helping Hand
videos.overview: While Sarah deals with issues at school, the Ninja Steel Rangers must overcome a force field.

videos.title: Galvanax Rises
videos.overview: Galvanax comes to Earth with a new, seemingly unstoppable plan to defeat the Power Rangers.

videos.title: Past, Presents and Future
videos.overview: Sarah teams up with Santa Claus to save Christmas and the Power Rangers from a time-manipulating monster.

videos.title: Echoes of Evil
videos.overview: Madame Odius returns to Earth to track down the Ninja Nexus Prism.

videos.title: Moment of Truth
videos.overview: When Calvin forgets his and Hayley's anniversary, he panics and ends up a spinning a web of lies to cover up his mistake.

videos.title: Tough Love
videos.overview: Levi tries to change himself to impress a mysterious street performer.

videos.title: Making Waves
videos.overview: When a monster threatens Summer Cove, the Rangers tap into the power of a new Megazord.

videos.title: Game Plan
videos.overview: The students of Summer Cove High become addicted to a new video game.

videos.title: Attack of the Galactic Ninjas
videos.overview: The Galactic Ninjas arrive on Earth to destroy the Rangers once and for all.

videos.title: The Need for Speed
videos.overview: Sarah tries to break the world hoverboard speed record using a strange new technology.

videos.title: Caught Red-Handed
videos.overview: Brody is accused of stealing something from one of his teachers.

videos.title: Outfoxed
videos.overview: After their Zords are disabled by Odius' giant Foxatron, the Rangers must find a new way to stop her evil Zord.

videos.title: Dimensions in Danger
videos.overview: In a very special 25th Anniversary episode, the Super Ninja Steel Rangers team up with Legendary Rangers in an epic battle to save the world.

videos.title: Love Stings
videos.overview: Preston learns not to believe everything he hears.

videos.title: Fan Frenzy
videos.overview: Levi becomes overwhelmed by an overzealous fan.

videos.title: Prepare to Fail
videos.overview: Sarah and the team's overconfidence puts them all at risk.

videos.title: Sheriff Skyfire
videos.overview: A Space Sheriff is tricked into attacking the Rangers; Hayley learns an important lesson about respecting school rules.

videos.title: Tech Support
videos.overview: The Rangers need the help of an unlikely ally when their technology is infected with a computer virus.

videos.title: Car Trouble
videos.overview: Calvin is faced with a tough decision when he is offered his dream job.

videos.title: Happy to Be Me
videos.overview: When a monster steals Levi's voice, he learns an important lesson about self-worth.

videos.title: Monster Mix-Up
videos.overview: The Super Ninja Steel Rangers are ambushed by monsters who switch bodies with them.

videos.title: Magic Misfire
videos.overview: One of Preston's spells accidentally causes unintended consequences for one of his favorite teachers which he must now fix.

videos.title: Doom Signal
videos.overview: Odius has a devious plan to create a massive army to control the world.

videos.title: Reaching the Nexus
videos.overview: The Rangers must figure out how to save the citizens of Summer Cove and stop Odius once and for all.

videos.title: The Poisy Show
videos.overview: The Rangers look to celebrate Christmas but find their holiday cheer interrupted by an old foe.

videos.title: Beasts Unleashed
videos.overview: Scientists tap into the Morphin Grid, but an evil virus corrupts the technology and a new team of Power Rangers is formed to defend the Grid from evil.

videos.title: Evox's Revenge
videos.overview: When Grid Battleforce’s Commander needs to select a leader for the team, the Power Rangers are at odds over who should get the job.

videos.title: End of the Road
videos.overview: Zoey tries to convince the citizens of Coral Harbor to use Morph-X powered bikes instead of cars, but Blaze uses the opportunity to execute an evil plan.

videos.title: Digital Deception
videos.overview: Ravi is shocked when the evil Roxy comes to his rescue and wonders if there may still be good left in her.

videos.title: Taking Care of Business
videos.overview: Devon finds it difficult to balance a new job he took to impress his dad and the duties of being the Red Power Ranger.

videos.title: Hangar Heist
videos.overview: Nate develops new technology from a captured Gigadrone and Devon struggles with fully trusting his team.

videos.title: A Friend Indeed
videos.overview: Evox targets the Beast Bots to stop the Rangers from forming their Megazord.

videos.title: The Cybergate Opens
videos.overview: Scrozzle executes his plan to finally free Evox from the Cyber Dimension and the Rangers, along with an unexpected friend, must do everything in their power to stop him.

videos.title: Silver Sacrifice
videos.overview: The Rangers must band together to save one of their own from Evox's new plan.

videos.title: Thrills and Drills
videos.overview: Ravi must face one of his worst fears when it interferes with his Ranger duties.

videos.title: Tools of the Betrayed
videos.overview: An innocent lie leads to a break in trust between the Power Rangers.

videos.title: Real Steel
videos.overview: When Nate and Steel unexpectedly clash, it leads to double trouble for the team.

videos.title: Tuba Triumph
videos.overview: After witnessing a boy being bullied, Ravi takes him under his wing.

videos.title: Hypnotic Halloween
videos.overview: The Rangers are hypnotized into believing that they are the characters they dressed up as for Halloween.

videos.title: Sound and Fury
videos.overview: The Rangers' skills are put to the test when Blaze uses evil tech to massively enhance his Robotron's destructive power.

videos.title: Seeing Red
videos.overview: The Red Ranger gets amazing new powers, but they have unexpected side effects.

videos.title: Gorilla Art
videos.overview: Ravi resorts to drastic measures when Smash accidentally discovers a closely guarded secret.

videos.title: Ranger Reveal
videos.overview: When a movie star comes to town, the Rangers' secret identities are unexpectedly threatened.

videos.title: Rewriting History
videos.overview: The Rangers are brainwashed to think that Blaze and Roxy are part of their team.

videos.title: Target: Tower
videos.overview: Evox and his minions hatch the ultimate plan to take over the Morphin Grid.

videos.title: Evox: Upgraded
videos.overview: The Rangers mount a desperate mission to stop Evox once and for all.

videos.title: Scrozzle's Revenge
videos.overview: When the Rangers get trapped inside holiday ornaments, their Beast Bots must save both the Rangers and the city.

videos.title: Believe It or Not
videos.overview: The Rangers are skeptical when Steel says he's found clues that proves Evox may have returned.

videos.title: Save Our Shores
videos.overview: A huge trash spill at the beach endangers the local wildlife; Scrozzle sets about finding reinforcements.

videos.title: Game On!
videos.overview: It’s not all fun and games when Devon’s favorite video game is brought to life in the form of a new Robotron.

videos.title: Artist Anonymous
videos.overview: Ravi secretly repaints a local art mural, but a strange artist arrives and claims the work as his own.

videos.title: Cruisin' for a Bruisin'
videos.overview: Devon discovers that Cruise has some skills that will help the Rangers in battle and pushes him to join the team.

videos.title: The Blame Game
videos.overview: Steel learns the concept of discipline and takes it too far, putting one of the Rangers in real danger.

videos.title: Beast King Rampage
videos.overview: The Rangers are given access to a powerful new Zord, but Evox has designs to steal it for himself.

videos.title: Boxed In
videos.overview: The Pan Global Games arrive in Coral Harbor, but Ranger duties prevent the teens from attending any of the events.

videos.title: Secret Struggle
videos.overview: Steel learns that Nate and Zoey have feelings for each other and tries to bring them together, despite the strict Grid Battleforce rules that forbid relationships between Rangers.

videos.title: The Evox Snare
videos.overview: Grid Battleforce shuts down the Morph-X towers to lure Evox into a trap.

videos.title: Intruder Alert!
videos.overview: The Rangers receive a strange message from outer space warning of an impending threat.

videos.title: The Greater Good
videos.overview: The Rangers do everything they can to help their new ally return home.

videos.title: Finders Keepers
videos.overview: A hasty decision by Zoey puts an old friend in danger.

videos.title: Making Bad
videos.overview: Evox decides to add a new villain to his team and commands his minions to find the evilest villain of all time.

videos.title: Grid Connection
videos.overview: In an epic battle, the Beast Morphers team up with the Dino Thunder, Dino Charge, and Mighty Morphin Power Rangers to defeat the newest member of Evox's team.

videos.title: Golden Opportunity
videos.overview: Nate is reunited with his do-gooder parents, who offer him a compelling and difficult choice.

videos.title: Goin' Ape
videos.overview: Ravi and Roxy's anniversary hits a major snag when a misunderstanding gets out of control.

videos.title: The Silva Switch
videos.overview: Nate and Steel accidentally swap bodies!

videos.title: Fossil Frenzy
videos.overview: When Zoey accidentally ruins her brother's chances for a scholarship, she’ll do anything to make it right.

videos.title: Crunch Time
videos.overview: Devon falls victim to a bad influence, which affects his relationship with Cruise.

videos.title: Source Code
videos.overview: Nate makes a horrifying discovery and must rely on the wisdom of an ally to help him work through it.

videos.title: Evox Unleashed
videos.overview: Evox finally executes his master plan, and the Rangers must do everything they can to stop him, even potentially sacrifice one of their own.

videos.title: Destination Dinohenge
videos.overview: Reporter Amelia accompanies Ollie and his mom, Dr. Akana, to investigate the mysterious Dinohenge statues; the trio run into an evil warrior named Void Knight and a threat that puts the entire world in danger.

videos.title: Sporix Unleashed
videos.overview: Ollie carries out a plan to catch Sporix without his teammates' knowledge; Ollie realizes the benefit of working as a team.

videos.title: Lost Signal
videos.overview: The Rangers intercept a mysterious message from outer space and Zayto is desperate to know if it was sent from his home planet; unable to decipher the message and losing hope, Zayto remembers another important message from the past.

videos.title: New Recruits
videos.overview: General Boomtower tries to steal a mysterious orb from the city museum; when the Rangers struggle to stop him, they get help from an unexpected source.

videos.title: Winning Attitude
videos.overview: Izzy is determined to win a big race with the help of her Special Olympics athlete cousin, Lily; after Lily misses a training session and Izzy rejects more help, her sportsmanship is put to the test.

videos.title: Superstition Strikes
videos.overview: Amelia thinks she's cursed with bad luck and is reluctant to help the Rangers, afraid she'll cause more harm; Amelia learns the truth about luck when monsters attack the base.

videos.title: Stego Search
videos.overview: The Warden takes away Javi's keytar, putting him in a bad mood, which he refuses to explain to the team. Javi is forced to open up about his problems in order to find his Zord.

videos.title: Unexpected Guest
videos.overview: A familiar face arrives on Earth and Zayto dismisses his quest as a distraction; after he saves the Rangers from a powerful Sporix Beast, Zayto realizes an important lesson.

videos.title: Cut Off
videos.overview: The Rangers tease Ollie for bringing all of his gadgets on a camping trip. But his tech might be their only hope when sinister Sporix suddenly attack.

videos.title: Phoning Home
videos.overview: A knight from Zayto's home planet suddenly appears at Dinohedge with a message that might be too good to be true... and Solon has her suspicions.

videos.title: McScary Manor
videos.overview: Amelia hunts for ghosts at a creepy mansion. But there's no supernatural sighting -- only a fierce face-off with pyramid-shaped Tombtress.

videos.title: Super Hotshot
videos.overview: Izzy is convinced a new coach is going to take her athletics to the next level. However, her training aspirations are put to the test when she discovers the coach's true motivations

videos.title: The Matchmaker
videos.overview: Javi thinks Izzy has a crush on a friend and he sets them up on a date, but his assumption causes big problems when the monsters smell love in the air.

videos.title: Old Foes
videos.overview: Ollie boasts to his friends that he's afraid of nothing. But when the other Dino Fury Rangers are captured by a formidable foe, Ollie realizes his biggest fear.

videos.title: Storm Surge
videos.overview: Ollie agrees to help Javi with a story, but his desire for new tech distracts him from his promise. The villains exploit his obsession, and Ollie learns a lesson about priorities.

videos.title: Ancient History
videos.overview: Aiyon, the new Gold Ranger, reveals the dark truth about Zayto's past and the Dino Fury Rangers learn what makes a true leader.

videos.title: Our Hero
videos.overview: Getting a free ice cream for a heroic act goes to Aiyon's head. But later on, when his Zord is captured, he learns what it means to be a true hero.

videos.title: Crossed Wires
videos.overview: Izzy attempts to hide her struggles in electronics class put the Rangers at risk when they need those skills during a battle.

videos.title: The Makeover
videos.overview: The villains use a Sporix Beast with body-swapping powers to chase pirate treasure, interrupting Amelia's attempts to make over Pop-Pop for a date.

videos.title: Waking Nightmares
videos.overview: Zayto is trapped on a distant planet seeking new Zords, and Aiyon makes a risky trip to save him. Together, they confront the nightmares of their past.

videos.title: Void Trap
videos.overview: The Rangers need Dr. Akana's help to stop Void Knight's evil scheme. But Ollie disagrees with Zayto's plan, afraid it will put his mother in danger.

videos.title: Secret Santa
videos.overview: While the Rangers fight to get Santa's magic sketchbook back from the villains, Javi and Solon are caught in a trap. Will they escape?

videos.title: Numero Uno
videos.overview: Void Knight suddenly returns, and a new member of his vicious crew joins Slyther and Mucus in tricking the Rangers and stealing a valuable Dino Key.

videos.title: The Festival
videos.overview: The Rangers must divide their fighting duties when Slyther and pirate robot Wreckmate challenge each other to see who can be more destructive.

videos.title: Missing Pieces
videos.overview: Solon's system gets an update. Javi, Izzy and the Rangers spot a Sporix beast — but not before evil Occulo tries to nab it first.

videos.title: Tiny Trouble
videos.overview: Aiyon reconnects with a shrunken Zord, but Occulo and Wreckmate try chasing it down for Void Knight's secret plans.

videos.title: Stitched Up
videos.overview: Izzy gets frustrated about the outfit her mom designed for the prom.  The Rangers battle a Sporix creature with an appetite for trash.

videos.title: Jam Session
videos.overview: Javi notices a powerful Dino Key on a band leader’s necklace. The Rangers power up to face off against Void Knight’s nasty new gizmo.

videos.title: New Leaf
videos.overview: Santaura convinces Void Knight and wicked Squashblight to contaminate the city’s water supply and turn all the residents into trees.

videos.title: Serious Business
videos.overview: The Rangers question Void Knight’s intentions. Santaura comes up with a new strategy to hunt down her former partner in crime.

videos.title: The Hunt
videos.overview: Amelia leads the crew on a search for a ghost caught on camera. A new robot programmed to crush and conquer hunts down the Rangers.

videos.title: Losers Weapers
videos.overview: Aiyon and Izzy find a secret stash of cash — and a powerful necklace that turns creatures mega-sized.

videos.title: The Copycat
videos.overview: Javi must come up with a new tune after his song for a competition is stolen. Mucus suggests a fresh way to beat the Rangers.

videos.title: Ultimate Mystery
videos.overview: When Jane vetoes a Buzzblast story on bigfoot, Amelia tells Stan and Annie to bend the rules and publish it anyway, but when her colleagues end up in danger, Amelia learns an important lesson about responsibility.

videos.title: Love Hate
videos.overview: Ollie tries to ask Amelia out, but a miscommunication leads to Amelia thinking he doesn't like her.

videos.title: Rafkon Revealed
videos.overview: The Ranger teens head to Rafkon to stop Lord Zedd, but because of a prophecy, Aiyon takes unnecessary risks.

videos.title: Morphin Master
videos.overview: The other Morphin Masters are angry to discover the Green Morphin Master has broken their vow to never intervene in mortal affairs. But when the Rangers and the Green Morphin Master work together, the Morphin Masters have a change of heart.

videos.title: Wishful Thinking
videos.overview: When a monster's meddling gives Javi a big break, he must come to terms with the fact that the key to success is hard work.

videos.title: Things Unspoken
videos.overview: Fern is offered a place at an elite sports college; Fern and Izzy's relationship is put to three test.

videos.title: Guilt Trip
videos.overview: Izzy is torn following Fern's acceptance to a faraway college. The Rangers try to stop Quickspine and Mucus from stealing Carlos' key.

videos.title: Bad Vibes
videos.overview: When Izzy and Javi are hit by blasts from a special weapon, they're brainwashed into helping the Void Queen with her plot to steal the Sporix.

videos.title: The Invasion
videos.overview: A band of Rafkonians arrive looking to colonize Earth, but the Rangers talk them into joining forces to stop the Void Queen's Sporix beasts.

videos.title: The Truth
videos.overview: As citizens flee in the wake of the Sporix beast invasion, the Rangers find an energy cocoon created by the Void Queen that could destroy Pine Ridge.

videos.title: The Nemesis
videos.overview: After Tarrick moves the energy cocoon outside of the city, the Rangers must do battle with the Void Queen and her massive Nemesis beast.

videos.title: Lightning Strikes
videos.overview: Bajillia enlists Lord Zedd to lead her armies in an intergalactic war — and things only get worse when the two capture a Power Ranger for their team.

videos.title: Beyond Repair
videos.overview: Team Cosmic Fury prepares for a possible invasion from Lord Zedd while Amelia tries to cure an evilized Ranger and Javi learns to accept his new loss.

videos.title: Off Grid
videos.overview: Stranded on a faraway planet with no powers, Team Cosmic Fury scrambles to figure out a way home while Earth suffers an invasion from enemy forces.

videos.title: Team Work
videos.overview: Ollie races Team Cosmic Fury to find Zayto, but the Zenith Ranger's location is anyone's guess. They'd better move fast though: Lord Zedd's forces loom!

videos.title: Rock Out
videos.overview: When Bajillia discovers a long-lost Zord on a mining planet, the Rangers must create a musical distraction to stop her from using it as a war weapon.

videos.title: Take Off
videos.overview: Solon goes missing right as the Rangers prepare to fly the base back to Earth. But the team has bigger problems: Ollie's tracker has led him to Erridus.

videos.title: Operation Seasoning
videos.overview: To save Pine Ridge, Team Cosmic Fury must dismantle the system of Squidrills creating an anti-Zord forcefield around Earth — with the help of a spy.

videos.title: Switching Sides
videos.overview: Two ex-villains should be the last people to cure Ollie, but Aiyon has a plan that just might work. Meanwhile, Zayto's secret becomes harder to hide.

videos.title: Master Plan
videos.overview: The connection to the Morphin Grid is in danger, unless the team can travel to Eltar and take back the Master Captivator and Ollie — without backup.

videos.title: The End
videos.overview: If Team Cosmic Fury can't stabilize the Master Captivator, a wave of pure evil threatens to wipe out all the good in the universe. No pressure, right?
